text: OVERDOSAGE Systemic toxicity following acute overdosage with topical application of Bexarotene gel is unlikely because of low systemic plasma levels observed with normal therapeutic doses. There is no specific antidote for overdosage. There has been no experience with acute overdose of Bexarotene gel in humans. Any overdose with Bexarotene gel should be treated with supportive care for the signs and symptoms exhibited by the patient.
